source: census runs/progress.jsonl wall_s and runs/manifest.json passes, all 79 audited census sessions (b = 26)
formula: est_s = 15 + passes * K * f(V) * (cheap_s * cheap_arms + ic_s * ic_arms); cheap arms = every arm except ic (rho, bsgs, rho-cubic, A/A)
K_definition: max over the 79 census sessions of ((wall_s - 15) / passes) / ((arms - 1) * 0.0415 + 0.15); the largest measured per-pass wall was 0.4456 s (6 arms)
f_definition: f(V) = max(1, sqrt(n_V / 10759409)); 10759409 = the largest r of a census volcano (V1)
session_cap_note: 27 min, so the 30 min limit holds with margin
maxpass_basis: V5: 6 cheap arms + ic (rho-cubic present on the crater specs, used for all V5 chunking); V6: 5 cheap arms + ic
